messages:
Maria G: Quick heads-up — entering a soft release embargo for the v3.6 train starting 18:00 UTC today. No non-critical merges after embargo unless you have an approved freeze-exception.
Maria G: Canary rollout window set for 09:00 UTC tomorrow. Targeting 2h canary with automatic health checks.
Maria G: TL;DR checklist:
```
- stop non-essential PR merges
- tag release candidate: rc/v3.6.0
- run canary smoke: deploy to canary pool A,B
- monitor latency, error-rate, and mem pressure
- rollback persona ready: fallback to v3.5 if regressions
```
Dan K: If someone needs a last-minute bugfix, what's the process?
Maria G: @Dan K — open a freeze-exception in the release channel and ping me + the release-shadow. We'll triage and approve only security/regression fixes.
Lee H: Canary prep done on my side. Binaries uploaded, smoke tests green on canary-1. Will push canary-2 at 09:00 UTC. :thumbsup:
Alice Z: Heads-up: embeddings-service has a small perf patch queued that would reduce tail latency but it's not critical. Should we include it in canary?
Maria G: Prefer not unless you need it to validate a customer-facing regression. Otherwise we schedule for next train. We want minimal churn during canary.
sre-bot: Canary health report (pre-rollout): cpu: nominal, latency-95: 120ms, errors: 0.00%. Ready to start.
deploy-bot: Scheduled: canary deploy at 09:00 UTC to pools canary-a and canary-b. Window: 2h. Notifications enabled.
Dan K: Noted. I'll be on rotation during the canary window. Ping me if the error-rate crosses 0.5%.
Maria G: Thanks — rotation list attached (in thread): Maria G, Dan K, Lee H, Alice Z. On-call escalation: @sre on pager.
Alice Z: If we see an embeddings spike, fallback plan is to route embeddings requests to the quantized model variant (v3.5-q) — approved?
Maria G: Approved. We'll toggle routing policy if latency SLOs breach 95th > 300ms for >5min.
Lee H: I'll prepare rollback runbook and smoke commands here before EOB.
Maria G: Good. Final note: release embargo lifts 2h after canary if everything is green, otherwise hold and investigate.
Dan K: :ok_hand:
Maria G: I'll post a brief canary check-in 30m into the window and another at +90m. Keep channel updates terse.
sre-bot: Reminder: automated alerts will post to #incidents if error-rate > 1% or p99 latency > 1s.
deploy-bot: Canary started at 09:00:00 UTC. Rolling to canary-a then canary-b.
sre-bot: Canary update +30m: canary-a ok, canary-b ok, no regressions detected, error-rate 0.02%.
Maria G: Looks good so far. Continue monitoring.
Alice Z: Monitoring embeddings tail — no spikes.
Lee H: Rollback docs: `scripts/rollback/v3.5_restore.sh` and k8s rollback commands ready.
Maria G: Thanks team — will reconvene if any anomalies. If you need a freeze exception, now is the time to raise it. :party_popper:
